verdict.rationale: Metorial's SDK docs show the platform running OAuth so users can authorize access to downstream services like Slack, GitHub and Google Calendar. Each user connects their own apps, environments keep separate authentication configs, and auth events are logged. Nothing in the pack confirms how the resulting credentials are stored or that tokens refresh automatically, and a community comment notes the auth handling is under-documented. Missing for 10: evidence of encrypted credential vaulting, automatic token refresh, independent or hands-on corroboration of the OAuth flow.
